description: This file contains pybind11 bindings for Torch C++ classes related to symbolic integers, floats, booleans, and scalars, including load and cast functions for type conversion between C++ and Python.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymInt>::load
methods.description: Loads a SymInt from a Python handle, checking for symbolic, variable, or index types.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymInt>::cast
methods.description: Casts a SymInt to a Python object, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymFloat>::load
methods.description: Loads a SymFloat from a Python handle, checking for symbolic or double types.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymFloat>::cast
methods.description: Casts a SymFloat to a Python object, handling symbolic and concrete cases.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymBool>::load
methods.description: Loads a SymBool from a Python handle, checking for symbolic or boolean types.

methods.name: type_caster<c10::SymBool>::cast
methods.description: Casts a SymBool to a Python object, handling symbolic and concrete cases.
